speaker: JAMIE
text: Six thousand agents is a number designed to make it sound like you've solved the problem before you've walked in the door.

speaker: JAMIE
text: Map your single most repetitive onboarding task. Not the whole journey, one task. Identify where the documentation bottleneck sits. Then test whether an agent can reliably summarise that step and trigger the right next notification. Gemini Enterprise is generally available on Google Cloud Platform, but it does require configuration of document connectors and agent workflows.

speaker: ALEX
text: And the honest question for anyone evaluating this: does the governance layer work at scale, or does it work in the controlled environments where these agents were designed? Regulated industries are not controlled environments. They have legacy systems, exceptions, edge cases, and infrastructure built in 2003.

speaker: ALEX
text: Watch for whether enterprise adopters share real deployment data — and whether the governance claims hold when a mid-size bank connects these agents to the system that predates the iPhone.
